question.en: Discuss the significance of Dedicated Freight Corridors in transforming India's logistics sector.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of Dedicated Freight Corridors in transforming India's logistics sector.

introduction.en: The Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) is a flagship infrastructure project aimed at creating high-capacity, high-speed rail corridors for freight.
introduction.hi: The Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) is a flagship infrastructure project aimed at creating high-capacity, high-speed rail corridors for freight.

body.en: It reduces transit time, lowers logistics costs, and decongests existing passenger lines. It supports the 'Make in India' initiative by improving industrial connectivity.
body.hi: It reduces transit time, lowers logistics costs, and decongests existing passenger lines. It supports the 'Make in India' initiative by improving industrial connectivity.

conclusion.en: DFC is a game-changer for India's economic growth and global competitiveness.
conclusion.hi: DFC is a game-changer for India's economic growth and global competitiveness.

valueAddition.en: Targeting a reduction in logistics cost from 14% to 8% of GDP.
valueAddition.hi: Targeting a reduction in logistics cost from 14% to 8% of GDP.
